prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Initializing Pet Behaviors & Desktop Assets"]
1: ["Calibrate Pet Desktop Docking", "Click and position your desktop companion to set its initial workspace dock zone.", "Position pet companion on screen", "Confirm Screen Placement"]
2: ["Live Companion Reaction Preview", "Hover over pet preview to test initial mood cues"]
3: ["Pet Hotkeys & System Tray Quick Actions", "Press Alt+P anytime to summon or hide your desktop pet, or right-click its system tray icon.", "Use Alt+P shortcut to toggle pet visibility", "Ready to Launch"]
4: ["Choose Your Pet Companion Journey", "Select between story-driven companionship or lightweight desk buddy mode.", "Select Companion Mode"]
5: ["Set Companion Sound & Window Sensitivity", "Adjust sound cue volume and set how your pet interacts with active application windows.", "Test Pet Chime Sound", "Save & Complete Setup"]
6: ["Personalize Your Official Adoption Certificate", "Select a commemorative seal to finalize your companion registration.", "Official Desk Companion Seal", "Stamp & Finalize"]
7: ["Play notification chime when pet is ready"]
8: ["Secure Your Pet & Enable Cloud Sync", "Signing in ensures your desktop companion's personality and unlocks remain safe across app restarts.", "Sign In to Save Pet Data"]
9: ["Desktop companions support multi-monitor setups and auto-adjust to screen resolution changes.", "Compatible with single & multi-monitor desktops"]
